title: Add an option to ignore all files, not just images
line: Clipboard settings have a new "Files copied or cut in a file manager" option; turning it off keeps copied files out of the clipboard history.
explanation: Klipper only had an option to leave out image data; files copied or cut in Dolphin or another file manager were always stored as history entries with thumbnails, pushing copied text out of the history. A new SaveFiles setting (default on, so nothing changes for existing users) adds a "Files copied or cut in a file manager" checkbox under "Include in history:". When it is off, clipboard data whose URLs are all local files, or that carries a file manager's cut/copy marker (application/x-kde-cutselection, x-special/gnome-copied-files), is not added to the history; the clipboard itself is untouched, so pasting the files still works.

commits.message:
klipper: add an option to not save copied files in the history

Files copied or cut in a file manager were always added to the clipboard
history, pushing copied text out, and only image data could be left out.
A new "Files copied or cut in a file manager" option now skips them.

BUG: 349509

media.caption: Master: two files copied in Dolphin land at the top of the clipboard history as thumbnail entries
With the option off: after clearing the history, text copied in an editor is saved, but the three files copied in Dolphin afterwards are not (they are still on the clipboard)
Master's clipboard settings: only selection and image data can be left out of the history
New "Files copied or cut in a file manager" option under Include in history (on by default)
